about: Malahide is a township in Elgin County, Ontario, surrounding the separate Town of Aylmer north of Lake Erie—not Aylmer itself. Hamlets such as Springfield and Port Bruce, creek mouths, and rich tobacco-and-field-crop country define the township. About 9,000 people live in Malahide Township.
seoSummary: Elgin County township around Aylmer—Springfield, Port Bruce, and Lake Erie farm country, not the Town of Aylmer.
